verdict.rationale: Brex documents automatic receipt matching: uploaded receipts are matched to existing expenses ([brex-docs-7], [brex-docs-27]). Marketing also says its AI assistants fetch receipts for employees ([brex-docs-23]) and that the review agent follows up with anyone out of compliance ([brex-docs-16]). However, nothing names e-receipt integrations or explains how receipts are pulled, and the follow-up behavior is only loosely tied to genuinely missing receipts. missing for 10: named e-receipt source integrations (e.g. travel/ride/merchant feeds) and how they pull receipts, explicit missing-receipt nudge logic that fires only when no receipt exists, in-depth product docs on employee-side matching beyond the API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
